sources.title: PDF Collision-Free Pick and Place with the SO-101 Robot Arm
sources.snippet: This project aimed to implement an autonomous pick-and-place system using the SO-101 robotic arm to grasp colored cubes and place them on a target surface. We successfully completed robot calibration and collected 90 demonstration samples (30 samples per each cube color : Yellow, Green, Red) capturing manipulation trajectories.
